## Access-event procedure

1. Verify the repository is clean and the branch tip matches its remote.
2. Run the command below with a real --operator and a --reason of substance; both are required and recorded.
3. The runner verifies every bound hash BEFORE touching the seal and refuses if any moved. A refusal leaves the access count at 0.
4. On success the access count becomes 1, permanently. There is no second run.

**Resume policy.** A crash after the unlock has already consumed the access event. Re-run with --resume to continue under the SAME event; a fresh run is refused with SECOND_RUN_REFUSED. An identity change on resume is refused with IDENTITY_MISMATCH.

## Formal verdict rules

- pass → `HISTORICAL_HOLDOUT_V5_PASS`
- fail → `HISTORICAL_HOLDOUT_V5_FAIL`
- invalid → `HISTORICAL_HOLDOUT_V5_INVALID_RUN`

Trait rule: direction opposite to the claim AND the 95% interval excludes zero AND |difference| > margin[metric]

Aggregate: minimum trait pass rate 0.75, maximum hard fails 0. no matchup may fail a majority of its scored traits. no era style may fail every scored trait of its matchup.

On failure: FAIL preserves every artifact, forbids tuning against V5, keeps Synthetic V2 sealed, and ends formal validation for Candidate 1. INVALID_RUN resumes under the SAME access event only.

Synthetic Stress Holdout V2 may be opened only AFTER Historical V5 passes. A historical failure keeps it sealed.
